summary: No blocking issues found. The compliant-wallet path was validated live; blocked-wallet browser validation needs a dedicated fixture or API mock.

comments.body: This test asserts fail-open behavior by forcing `submitRequestToBackground` to reject even though Redux has a cached blocked status. In the actual background API, `complianceCheckWalletsCompliance` is bound to `ComplianceController.checkWalletsCompliance`, and `@metamask/compliance-controller@2.0.0` can fall back to cached per-address statuses on service failure. If the desired contract is fail-open even when a blocked cached status exists, this needs a test closer to the real controller behavior; otherwise this assertion gives false confidence about outage behavior.
